findings:
COMPLETED. Task 1.2 (examples) + Task 1.4 (docs) done together.

New example: added xplainit-core/examples/real_world_debugging.rs. It uses only the public xplainit-core API: records FunctionEnter/VariableAssign/DivisionByZero/FunctionExit events into an EventStore for a realistic checkout(order=[]) scenario, replays them as natural-language explanations via ExplanationGenerator (Normal verbosity), and runs ErrorExplainer::analyze on the error event to print severity/category/root cause/fix suggestions/prevention tips, plus a session-stats summary. Builds clean and runs to completion with clear educational output.

All examples verified: cargo build --release --examples -p xplainit-core exits 0; cargo run --release --example <name> -p xplainit-core succeeds for basic_usage, custom_filters, event_pipeline, error_analysis, ast_parsing, demo_simple, and real_world_debugging. cargo clippy -p xplainit-core --all-targets -- -D warnings is clean (0 warnings).
